_meta.note: Numeric thresholds are DERIVED (see VALUE_AND_NOTAN.md section 5) and need calibration; form_check code in VALUE_AND_NOTAN.md section 6.

errors.name: Mud: everything mid-value
errors.symptom: Image looks grey and flat; nothing pops at thumbnail size.
errors.why_it_fails: Form and depth are carried by luminance; without value groups the first-glance gist has no structure.
errors.how_to_detect: form_check: mid group > 60% and thumb32_rms < 0.08; L p2-p98 span < 0.30 without an intended compressed style.
errors.fix: Re-plan notan; push one group darker/lighter; add full-range accents at the focal area.

errors.name: Spotty notan (scattered values)
errors.symptom: Many small darks/lights everywhere; eye jumps around.
errors.why_it_fails: Ungrouped values give many competing contrast peaks and no dominant mass.
errors.how_to_detect: Count connected components of the dark mask > 0.5% of the area: many (> 8, derived) with no component > 20% of the dark area.
errors.fix: Weld adjacent similar values into one mass; remove or lighten small darks away from focal.

errors.name: Competing focal contrast
errors.symptom: A bright window, sign or text block outshouts the glasses.
errors.why_it_fails: Gaze is drawn to local contrast and edges; two equal peaks split attention.
errors.how_to_detect: form_check with ROI=focal: focal_share_top5_contrast < 2 x focal_area_share; saliency peak outside the focal ROI in analyze_image overlay.
errors.fix: Compress/dim the competitor (HTML filter, vignette), raise contrast at focal, or crop.

errors.name: Equiluminant hero
errors.symptom: Subject differs from ground only by hue; shimmers or vanishes in greyscale.
errors.why_it_fails: Equal-luminance colours flatten form and blur position; greyscale gist loses the subject.
errors.how_to_detect: deltaL_focal_vs_surround < 0.05 while hue/chroma differ strongly; subject not visible in greyscale 64 px.
errors.fix: Separate by value (>= 0.10, hero >= 0.26 OKLab L); keep the hue idea but shift lightness.

errors.name: Clipped highlights / crushed shadows
errors.symptom: White blobs with no detail on lenses or skin; black holes in shadows.
errors.why_it_fails: Tone reproduction failed to compress highlights smoothly; detail and form are lost.
errors.how_to_detect: analyze_image: clipped_highlights_pct > 0.5 (excluding tiny speculars) or crushed_shadows_pct > 2 when not intended.
errors.fix: Regenerate with softer key, or apply a roll-off curve; protect the product area.

errors.name: HDR halo / over-local tone mapping
errors.symptom: Glowing halos around edges, everything equally contrasty, gritty texture.
errors.why_it_fails: Aggressive local compression destroys contrast hierarchy and creates false edges.
errors.how_to_detect: Bright/dark bands 5-30 px wide along major edges (visual check at 100%); local contrast uniform across frame (focal_share_top5_contrast close to focal_area_share).
errors.fix: Reduce local tone mapping/clarity; rebuild hierarchy with a global curve and vignette.

errors.name: Washed-out high key
errors.symptom: Light image with no real dark; figures barely visible.
errors.why_it_fails: High key needs a dark accent to carry focus; without it the gist has nothing to grab.
errors.how_to_detect: key=high and L p2 > 0.45, or thumb32_rms < 0.08 (observed on faint charcoal slides).
errors.fix: Darken the focal figure/accent; strengthen line weight on silhouettes.

errors.name: Light shadows / opaque shadows
errors.symptom: Shadow regions lighter than nearby lit areas, or flat painted patches hiding the surface.
errors.why_it_fails: Shadows must be locally darker and slightly desaturated, and transparent, to read as shadows.
errors.how_to_detect: Sample L and chroma: shadow L >= adjacent lit L, or shadow chroma higher than lit chroma; texture inside shadow fully gone.
errors.fix: Darken and desaturate shadows; let texture show through; keep reflected light darker than the light family.

errors.name: Inconsistent or bottom light direction
errors.symptom: Bumps read as dents; shadows point different ways.
errors.why_it_fails: Shape-from-shading assumes light from above; conflicting directions break form reading.
errors.how_to_detect: Visual check of cast-shadow directions and highlight positions; flag light from below unless intended (horror/campfire).
errors.fix: Unify one key direction (default upper-left); regenerate or repaint shadows in HTML.

errors.name: Uniform hard edges (sticker / cut-out look)
errors.symptom: Every edge equally sharp; composited frame looks pasted on.
errors.why_it_fails: No edge hierarchy; depth cues from edge softness missing; the eye has no single anchor.
errors.how_to_detect: edge_density_focal_vs_rest < 1.2 with high overall edge density; cutout edge transition 0 px while background is blurred.
errors.fix: Apply the edge ladder: one hard edge at focal, firm silhouettes, soft turning forms; feather cutout 0.5-1 px and add contact shadow.

errors.name: Uniform softness (no found edge)
errors.symptom: Whole image soft/blurred; nothing to lock onto.
errors.why_it_fails: Without a sharp, high-contrast edge or detail peak, gaze wanders and the focal point is weak.
errors.how_to_detect: Laplacian variance of the focal ROI not higher than the rest (detail_ratio_focal_vs_rest < 1.2); overall Laplacian energy low.
errors.fix: Sharpen/restore detail on the focal object only; add one specular or rim edge.

errors.name: Wire outline (uniform line weight)
errors.symptom: Line art looks like a colouring book; forms flat.
errors.why_it_fails: Line weight cues for depth, size and light are missing.
errors.how_to_detect: Measure stroke width (distance transform on the ink mask): silhouette/interior ratio < 1.3 and coefficient of variation of width very low.
errors.fix: Apply the line-weight ladder (silhouette 1.5-2x interior; heavier on shadow side; taper free ends).

errors.name: Outlined shadows / false contours
errors.symptom: Lines drawn around shadow shapes or reflections; form reads as patches.
errors.why_it_fails: Lines are read as depth/slant discontinuities; shadow borders drawn as lines become false object boundaries.
errors.how_to_detect: Visual check: lines that do not lie on occluding contours or creases; compare with the expected contour set.
errors.fix: Remove shadow outlines; express shadow with tone or hatching.

errors.name: Broken junctions and tangents
errors.symptom: Lines cross through overlaps, gaps at overlaps, or edges just touching; depth order unclear.
errors.why_it_fails: T-junctions signal occlusion; crossings read as transparency, tangents are ambiguous.
errors.how_to_detect: Inspect overlaps at 100%: far lines must stop at near contours; flag edges touching within ~3 px without overlapping.
errors.fix: Redraw overlaps as clean T-junctions; move shapes to overlap clearly or separate.

errors.name: Empty lens (no transparency cue)
errors.symptom: Cutout glasses look like empty wire frames.
errors.why_it_fails: Transparency reads from X-junctions and reflections; without them the lens is perceived as absent.
errors.how_to_detect: Background edges behind the lens unchanged (no tint/offset) and no reflection band.
errors.fix: Add the lens layer: slight tint/value shift of background lines through the lens plus one soft reflection.

errors.name: Detail everywhere (AI clutter)
errors.symptom: Every surface densely textured and sharp; busy, tiring image.
errors.why_it_fails: Peripheral vision summarises detail into noise; clutter makes it hard for anything to capture attention.
errors.how_to_detect: edge_density > 0.15 (line art) with edge_density_focal_vs_rest < 1.2; text box edge density > 0.03.
errors.fix: Blur/flatten background in HTML, prompt 'simple uncluttered background', remove props.

errors.name: Detail in the wrong place
errors.symptom: Background or a secondary object is sharper and more detailed than the product.
errors.why_it_fails: Selective detail attracts and holds gaze; misplaced detail pulls the eye off the hero.
errors.how_to_detect: detail_ratio_focal_vs_rest < 1 with ROI on the product.
errors.fix: Swap: soften the distracting area, restore detail on the product (use the real frame photo).

errors.name: Crowded small details
errors.symptom: Small logo, price or engraving near other detail is overlooked or unreadable.
errors.why_it_fails: Crowding prevents identification of small items surrounded by clutter in the periphery.
errors.how_to_detect: Small element with other edges within ~1x its own size; low local contrast around it.
errors.fix: Give clear space, increase size/contrast, or bring it to centre with a punch-in.

errors.name: Unreadable silhouette
errors.symptom: Subject merges with background or its own limbs; cannot tell what it is at 64 px.
errors.why_it_fails: Identification from silhouettes depends on view and separation; merged shapes lose the cue.
errors.how_to_detect: Fill subject mask black at 64 px - not identifiable; deltaL_focal_vs_surround < 0.10.
errors.fix: Change view/pose (arms off body, 3/4 frame view), separate by value or rim light.

errors.name: Twin silhouettes (Mint = Tao)
errors.symptom: The two faceless characters look interchangeable.
errors.why_it_fails: With identical heads and no faces, identity must come from body shape, value and gesture.
errors.how_to_detect: Height-normalised silhouette IoU >= 0.75 or aspect ratios within 15% (derived); same clothing value.
errors.fix: Restore primary shape contrast (round bundled vs tall narrow coat) and light vs dark clothing; spell it out per figure in the prompt.

errors.name: Shape monotony
errors.symptom: All shapes similar size and type; no rhythm or focal break.
errors.why_it_fails: No hierarchy or pattern break; grouping makes everything one texture.
errors.how_to_detect: Distribution of contour areas narrow (largest < 2x median, derived); circularity values all in one cluster with no outlier at focal.
errors.fix: Apply big-medium-small; add one contrasting shape at the focal point.

errors.name: Stiff mannequin pose
errors.symptom: Faceless figures stand straight with arms at sides; no emotion reads.
errors.why_it_fails: Faceless characters rely on gesture; an I-pose without line of action carries no emotion.
errors.how_to_detect: Visual check: no identifiable C/S curve through head-spine-legs; arms overlapping torso.
errors.fix: Prompt actions and curves ('curling forward, head bowed', 'leaning toward'), exaggerate the key pose.

errors.name: Trapped or sliver negative space
errors.symptom: Odd leftover gaps or thin slivers along frame edges draw the eye.
errors.why_it_fails: Negative shapes are perceived as shapes; awkward ones compete and look accidental.
errors.how_to_detect: Find background regions touching the frame edge with width < 3% of the frame side; enclosed gaps with odd outlines (visual).
errors.fix: Move/crop so gaps are clearly large or clearly closed; keep text zone one clean shape.
